$$
    F = \frac{MS_{Treatments}}{MS_{Error}} = \frac{\frac{\sum_j^k n_j (\bar{X_j} - \bar{X})^2}{k - 1}}{\frac{\sum_j \sum (X - \bar{X_j})^2}{N - k}}
$${#eq-anova}
